pages.text: Checks whether a server answers and returns an exit code instead of crashing.$(br2)The exit code is 0 if the server answers, 1 if it answers with an error status and 2 if there is no answer. A comparator next to the trigger block reads it.

$(1)PROGRAM ping$(br)NOOP$(br)INCLUDE c0de_net/http$(br)NOOP$(br)FUNCTION check$(br)  PARAMETER host STRING$(br)BEGIN$(br)  VARIABLE api STRUCT c0de_net/http/HTTP_CONNECTION$(br)  VARIABLE problem ERROR$(br)  ASSIGN api.use_ssl TRUE ;$(br)  ASSIGN api.server host ;$(br)  ASSIGN api.timeout 5 ;$()

$(1)  CALL c0de_net/http/HTTP_HEAD problem$(br)    PARAMETER connection api ;$(br)  IF problem.code = 1000 ;$(br)  BEGIN$(br)    EXIT 1 ;$(br)  END IF$(br)  IF problem.code ≠ 0 ;$(br)  BEGIN$(br)    EXIT 2 ;$(br)  END IF$(br)  EXIT 0 ;$(br)END FUNCTION$()
